decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the proposed alteration of the rear elevation of the dwelling, the erection of a porch and alterations to doors and windows on the front elevation, replacement of existing shutter door on garage, erection of a small wall to front elevation of the house and internal alterations, as shown on drawings 041-001, 041-010, 044-011, 044-030 (Existing front elevation), 044-030 (Existing rear elevation), 044-110, 044-111, 044-130, 044-131 & 044-132, received 9th May 2006, satisfactorily complies with the relevant UDP policies and Supplementary Planning Guidance as it would be compatible with the scale, character and form of the original building, would maintain the amenity of neighbouring properties and have no negative impact on the existing street scene or the Chiswick House Conservation Area.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Alterations to rear elevation erection of single storey porch alterations to doors and windows to front elevation. Replacement of existing shutter doors to garage and incorporate store and utility room to garage and erection of small wall to front elevation to house.
